digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center outbound comment send path
propositions: Jira Data Center outbound comment send path applies no length fitting, causing over-length comments to be rejected by Jira and re-emitted on every reconciliation pass
_DCSanitizer.sanitize_comment exists but has no production caller; the fitting logic is dead code in DC's send path
_DCSanitizer.fit_comment does not match the marker-stripped body that actually lands, breaking dedup-key consistency with the convergence pair
DC send path must be wired to apply marker-preserving fitting via fit_preserving_marker at the deployment-resolved comment_max_chars() ceiling
fit_comment must be re-derived via fit_comment_as_sent to ensure the dedup key equals the marker-stripped landed body
Cloud's dead sanitize_comment method and its protocol declaration must be removed to prevent future wiring of the incorrect 32,767-char cap that would truncate RECONCILER_MARKER
